```{r create the british empire}
# Introducing a tribble . . . 
# data can be entered column by column!
# good for small data frames

british_empire_pairs <- tribble(
  ~country_from_alpha_code, ~country_to_alpha_code,
  "IND", "GBR",
  "PAK", "GBR",
  "BGD", "GBR",
  "NGA", "GBR",
  "GHA", "GBR",
  "KEN", "GBR",
  "ZAF", "GBR",
  "ZWE", "GBR",
  "JAM", "GBR",
  "TTO", "GBR",
  "BRB", "GBR",
  "CYP", "GBR",
  "MLT", "GBR",
  "AUS", "GBR",
  "NZL", "GBR",
  "CAN", "GBR",
  "SGP", "GBR",
  "MYS", "GBR",
  "HKG", "GBR",
  "IRE", "GBR",   # Noted
  "UGA", "GBR",
  "TZA", "GBR",
  "ZMB", "GBR",
  "MWI", "GBR",
  "SLE", "GBR",
  "GUY", "GBR",
  "MMR", "GBR",   # Noted

  mutate(british_empire = 1L)
```
